name: Buriti palm
desc: A palm of wet ground that Wikipedia says tapirs, peccaries, fish and monkeys depend on for its fruit. It marks the vereda wetlands.
about: Mauritia flexuosa, known as the moriche palm, ité palm, ita, buriti, muriti, miriti (Brazil), canangucho (Colombia), morete or acho (Ecuador), palma real (Bolivia), or aguaje (Peru), is a palm tree.
